name: Bruno Krauss
biography: Bruno Krauss is a software engineer and Bitcoin enthusiast. He demonstrated his knack for password cracking at the age of 13 by bypassing his secondary school's IT security to mine BTC on their PCs and now specializes in cryptocurrency recovery.
